info.title: API.SH: Booli
info.description: The Booli API from API.SH: public Booli data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An estate agency on Booli: name, logo, offices, agents (rating, reviews) and current listings, optionally for one area. 24 listings per page; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booli-agency

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The agency's slug as in booli.se/maklarbyra/<slug>, or that link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An estate agent's public profile on Booli: name, photo, business phone and email, rating, review count, recommendations, listing statistics for the last six months, agency, and the agent's current listings (24 per page). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booli-agent

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The agent's slug as in booli.se/maklare/<slug>, or that link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Booli estate agents in an area
get.description:
Estate agents active in an area as ranked on Booli's agent pages: name, agency, photo, rating, review count, whether sellers' favourite, listings published, recommendations and total value published. 25 per page; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booli-agents

parameters.name: area_slug
parameters.description: The area as in booli.se/maklare/<area>, e.g. stockholm, goteborg, malmo, uppsala.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Housing market statistics for an area on Booli for apartments or houses: average sold price, sold price per m², bidders per sale, share of homes with price cuts, price premium over list price, supply, upcoming sales and days on market, each for the last month and the last 12 months, plus the site's short text about the area.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booli-area-stats

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: A Booli area id (see /booli/v1/suggest) or a place name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Booli listing (for sale, coming soon, sold or removed): address, apartment number, area tree, coordinates, home type, tenure, status, list price and price changes, price per m², rooms, living/additional/plot area, floor and building floors, monthly fee, operating cost, construction year, heating, mortgage deeds, amenities, Booli's price estimate with range, upcoming viewings, agent and agency, the broker's own listing link, housing cooperative id, the sale result when sold, earlier sales of the same home, the listing's history on Booli (price changes, status changes), fact lines and all photos.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booli-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Booli listing id or a booli.se/annons/<id> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every recorded sale of one home (a booli.se/bostad/<id> property, or the home behind a listing id): sale date, sold price, list price, price change, price per m², rooms, living area, area, municipality, agent and agency.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booli-property

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Booli property id or a booli.se/bostad/<id> link (a booli.se/annons/<id> link also works).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Homes for sale in Sweden on Booli for an area, with every filter the site offers (home type, rooms, living and plot area, price, price per m², monthly fee, construction year, floor, balcony/fireplace/elevator, tenure, days on Booli, viewings, distance to water, new construction, upcoming sales, price cuts) and every sort. Each result has id, link, address, area, home type, list price, rooms, living area, floor, monthly fee or plot area, municipality, county, coordinates, amenities, up to 5 photos, status (e.g. next viewing) and the presenting agency. Also returns the total, the applied filters as Booli describes them and related searches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Or pass any booli.se/sok/till-salu link as url.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booli-search

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: A Booli area id (1 = Stockholm municipality, 2 = Stockholm county; ids from /booli/v1/suggest), several ids comma-separated, or a place name (the site's best match is used and returned as resolved_area). Required unless url is given.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A booli.se/sok/till-salu search link with its filters (instead of area and filters).

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Home type, comma-separated: apartment, villa, townhouse, holiday_home, plot, farm (or the site's Swedish names).

parameters.name: tenure
parameters.description: Comma-separated: cooperative (bostadsrätt), freehold (äganderätt), site_leasehold, lease, owner_apartment, share.

parameters.name: extend_km
parameters.description: Widen the area by this many km: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 or 30.

parameters.name: max_monthly_fee
parameters.description: Maximum monthly fee to the cooperative, SEK.

parameters.name: days_active
parameters.description: Listed on Booli within this many days: 1, 3, 7 or 30.

parameters.name: new_construction
parameters.description: include (default), only, exclude, or projects (new-build projects).

parameters.name: upcoming_sale
parameters.description: include (default), only or exclude homes coming soon.

parameters.name: price_decreased
parameters.description: true: only homes whose price was cut.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest, oldest, price_asc, price_desc, rooms_desc, area_desc, area_asc, fee_asc, sqm_price_asc, sqm_price_desc, plot_desc, plot_asc, address_asc, address_desc.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Lägenheter till salu i Stockholms kommun

get.description:
Final sale prices (slutpriser) in Sweden on Booli for an area, with the site's filters (home type, rooms, living and plot area, sold price, price per m², construction year, amenities, tenure, sale date range) and sorts. Each result has id, link, address, area, home type, sold price, sale date, price per m², rooms, living area, floor or plot area, coordinates, photos and municipality. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Or pass any booli.se/sok/slutpriser link as url.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booli-sold

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: A Booli area id (1 = Stockholm municipality, 2 = Stockholm county; ids from /booli/v1/suggest), several ids comma-separated, or a place name (the site's best match is used and returned as resolved_area). Required unless url is given.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A booli.se/sok/slutpriser search link with its filters (instead of area and filters).

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Home type, comma-separated: apartment, villa, townhouse, holiday_home, plot, farm (or the site's Swedish names).

parameters.name: tenure
parameters.description: Comma-separated: cooperative (bostadsrätt), freehold (äganderätt), site_leasehold, lease, owner_apartment, share.

parameters.name: extend_km
parameters.description: Widen the area by this many km: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 or 30.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default, by sale date), oldest, recently_added, price_change_desc, price_change_asc, price_asc, price_desc, rooms_desc, area_desc, area_asc, sqm_price_asc, sqm_price_desc, plot_desc, plot_asc, address_asc, address_desc.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Slutpriser för lägenheter i Stockholms kommun

get.description:
The areas Booli suggests for what was typed (municipalities, counties, districts, streets and named areas), each with its id for the search routes, type and parent area.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/booli-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A place name, part of one, or a street.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
